text:
noemi: hi all, new runtime dev here. building from source and getting undefined reference to cufftExec in link step.

noemi: build cmd: `./build.sh --targets=runtime` 
noemi: link excerpt:
```
/usr/bin/ld: CMakeFiles/runtime.dir/backends/cuda/cufft_wrapper.o: in function `init_fft':
cufft_wrapper.o: undefined reference to `cufftExecC2C'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

carlos: welcome! :wave: that symbol is from cuFFT. likely toolkit mismatch or missing -lcufft. which CUDA toolkit do you have? `nvcc --version` and `ldconfig -p | grep cufft`?

noemi: `nvcc --version` -> Cuda compilation tools, release 12.1
noemi: `ldconfig -p | grep cufft` -> nothing

zhen: if ldconfig doesn't list cufft it means system libs not pointing to toolkit. did you run `scripts/setup_cuda.sh`? also check `/usr/local/cuda/lib64` exists. our build expects `-lcufft` to be pulled in by target_link_libraries, but if cmake finds headers from one install and libs missing it fails.

noemi: i installed cuda-toolkit via distro package earlier; the headers were at /usr/local/cuda-12.1 but libs were in /opt/cuda-12.2 from a runfile leftover. messy.

carlos: common. easiest is to standardize on one install. either remove the distro toolkit or point CUDA_HOME to the runfile path. run `export CUDA_HOME=/opt/cuda-12.2 && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$CUDA_HOME/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH` and then `rm -rf build && ./build.sh --clean && ./build.sh --targets=runtime`.

noemi: did that, but still `undefined reference to cufftExecC2C`. i also tried adding `-lcufft` to CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS and it still complains.

zhen: double-check `ldd build/bin/runtime | grep cufft` after build attempt; if the binary isn't linked yet, inspect `build/link_command.txt` (we dump the final link line to that file). make sure `-L/opt/cuda-12.2/lib64 -lcufft` is present. sometimes our third_party/cuda_compat overrides cufft and expects a stub; see `third_party/cuda_compat/README.md`.

noemi: found build/link_command.txt and it didn't include -lcufft. i patched `cmake/FindCUDA.cmake` locally to prefer cufft and reran cmake. link now succeeds and tests run.

carlos: nice. if you can, push a tiny PR to add a check that cufft is found and linked, or update the setup script to set CUDA_HOME earlier. thanks and welcome.

build-bot: build passed for commit abc123 on linux-x86_64. :tada:

onboard-bot: Welcome noemi! Please complete the "Runtime dev setup" checklist in Notion and file your environment details in the onboarding doc.

noemi: will do, thanks everyone!
_description: New hire hits undefined reference to cuFFT (cufftExec) due to mixed CUDA installs and missing -lcufft in link line. Team suggests standardizing CUDA_HOME/LD_LIBRARY_PATH, checking link_command.txt, and adding a CMake check or setup script fix.
